## Notes

Trained on the 3D game Yuan Meng Star; Yan-Sim 1080p 50-60 fps with ~0.07 s latency; Yan-Gen 12-17 fps on one H20, ~30 fps on 4; editing module separates mechanics simulation from rendering and supports text edits during interaction.
